description: This file defines the 'DbSession' class, a wrapper around Hibernate's Session interface to provide backwards compatibility across different Hibernate versions. It includes methods for transaction management, query creation, entity operations, session configuration, and other session-related functionalities within the OpenMRS project.

classes.name: DbSession
classes.description: A wrapper class around Hibernate's Session to support backwards compatibility and additional session management functionalities in the OpenMRS project.

methods.name: getTenantIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the tenant identifier associated with this session.

methods.name: beginTransaction
methods.description: Starts a new transaction in the current session.

methods.name: getTransaction
methods.description: Retrieves the current transaction associated with this session.

methods.name: getNamedQuery
methods.description: Creates a Hibernate Query for a named query defined in metadata.

methods.name: createQuery
methods.description: Creates a Hibernate Query for an HQL string.

methods.name: createSQLQuery
methods.description: Creates a SQLQuery for a raw SQL string.

methods.name: getNamedProcedureCall
methods.description: Gets a ProcedureCall based on a named template.

methods.name: createStoredProcedureCall
methods.description: Creates a call to a stored procedure by name.

methods.name: createStoredProcedureCall
methods.description: Creates a stored procedure call with result set entity mappings.

methods.name: createCriteria
methods.description: Creates a Criteria query for a given entity class or name.

methods.name: sessionWithOptions
methods.description: Returns a session builder for configuring session options.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes the session, synchronizing in-memory state with the database.

methods.name: setFlushMode
methods.description: Sets the flush mode for this session.

methods.name: getFlushMode
methods.description: Gets the current flush mode of this session.

methods.name: setCacheMode
methods.description: Sets the cache mode for this session.

methods.name: getCacheMode
methods.description: Gets the current cache mode.

methods.name: getSessionFactory
methods.description: Returns the SessionFactory that created this session.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the session, releasing JDBC connection resources.

methods.name: cancelQuery
methods.description: Cancels the current running query.

methods.name: isOpen
methods.description: Checks if the session is open.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the session is connected.

methods.name: isDirty
methods.description: Determines if the session has pending changes that need to be synchronized.

methods.name: isDefaultReadOnly
methods.description: Checks if entities loaded into the session are defaulted to read-only.

methods.name: setDefaultReadOnly
methods.description: Sets whether entities loaded are defaulted to read-only.

methods.name: getIdentifier
methods.description: Obtains the identifier of a persistent entity object.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if an entity instance is associated with this session.

methods.name: evict
methods.description: Removes an entity from the session cache.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a persistent entity by class and identifier, with optional lock options.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a persistent entity by entity name and identifier, with lock options.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads an entity by class and identifier, assuming it exists.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads an entity by name and identifier, assuming it exists.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads an entity instance into an existing object.

methods.name: replicate
methods.description: Replaces the state of a detached entity into the current session with specified replication mode.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persists a transient object, returning its generated identifier.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persists a transient object with entity name and returns its identifier.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves or updates the given object depending on its state.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates a persistent object with the same identifier.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges the state of a detached object into the current session.

methods.name: persist
methods.description: Makes a transient instance persistent.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a persistent instance from the datastore.

methods.name: buildLockRequest
methods.description: Creates a LockRequest for locking an entity with given LockOptions.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Re-reads the state of an entity or collection from the database.

methods.name: getCurrentLockMode
methods.description: Gets the current lock mode of a persistent object.

methods.name: createFilter
methods.description: Creates a filter for a collection with a query string.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the session, evicting all loaded instances.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a persistent instance by class and id, or null if not found.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a persistent instance with lock options.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a persistent entity by entity name and id.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a persistent entity with lock options.

methods.name: getEntityName
methods.description: Returns the entity name of a given persistent object.

methods.name: byId
methods.description: Creates an IdentifierLoadAccess for an entity by class or name.

methods.name: byNaturalId
methods.description: Creates a NaturalIdLoadAccess for an entity by class or name.

methods.name: bySimpleNaturalId
methods.description: Creates a SimpleNaturalIdLoadAccess for an entity by class or name.

methods.name: enableFilter
methods.description: Enables a named filter on the current session.

methods.name: getEnabledFilter
methods.description: Retrieves an enabled filter by name.

methods.name: disableFilter
methods.description: Disables a named filter.

methods.name: getStatistics
methods.description: Gets statistics for the current session.

methods.name: isReadOnly
methods.description: Checks if an entity or proxy is read-only.

methods.name: setReadOnly
methods.description: Sets an entity or proxy's read-only status.

methods.name: doWork
methods.description: Executes JDBC work using the session’s connection.

methods.name: doReturningWork
methods.description: Executes JDBC work with a returned result.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the session from its JDBC connection.

methods.name: reconnect
methods.description: Reconnects the session to a JDBC connection.

methods.name: isFetchProfileEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a fetch profile is enabled.

methods.name: enableFetchProfile
methods.description: Enables a fetch profile.

methods.name: disableFetchProfile
methods.description: Disables a fetch profile.

methods.name: getTypeHelper
methods.description: Provides access to the session's TypeHelper.

methods.name: getLobHelper
methods.description: Provides access to LobHelper for creating LOBs.

methods.name: addEventListeners
methods.description: Adds event listeners to the session.
